text:
Sarika (CSM): Heads up team — Clearsky is moving to Dedicated next week. Need a quick sync on quota priming, autoscale profile, and load test window. Renewal conversation also tied to SLA metrics :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ana (Solutions): Thanks — are we still targeting 8xA100 reserved? Customer expects ~2.5k concurrent sessions at peak, mostly chat gen.
Matt (Infra): Yes 8xA100 reserved. We validated model fits 1.5k concurrent per pool with current batching. We'll need to tune batch size and prefix cache.
Jess (Oncall): I can own the load test run. Propose Wed 09:00 PT for smoke -> Wed 12:00 PT for soak. Short checklist: warm caches, prime KV, run traffic with realistic prompt mix.
Sarika (CSM): Wed works for customer. Can we get an ops checklist and a quick failover plan? Customer worried about tail latency impacting renewal.
Tim (SRE): SLA target we promised is p95 < 700ms for short chats. For this model/len distribution, aim for p95 < 900ms during soak. We'll test autoscale cooldowns.
Ana (Solutions): Ops checklist (draft):
```
- reserve pool 8xA100
- set autoscale policy: min=4 max=12 target_util=0.65 cooldown=300s
- prewarm KV cache via replay script
- enable slowpath fallback to smaller-quantized variant
- validate KMS access and audit logs
```
Matt (Infra): A couple notes: 1) target_util should be per-GPU busy fraction; 0.65 is good. 2) cooldown 300s avoids oscillation with bursty traffic. 3) We'll set a headroom throttle at 85% to trigger fallback.
Jess (Oncall): Load script: `./tools/traffic-replay --profile clearsky_peak --qps 350 --duration 3h`
Jess (Oncall): Will run smoke first (15m), then ramp to target over 20m, then steady soak. Will upload result CSV to the run folder and ping here.
DeployBot: Deployment queued for pool `clearsky-reserved-171843`: image v2.4.1, cfg `autoscale-v3`. ETA ~13m.
Sarika (CSM): Important for renewal: we'll capture p50/p95/p99, error rate, and cost delta vs hosted. I'll share those with customer in the review.
Tim (SRE): Alerts to create before soak:
- high-queue-depth > 30s for 5m
- error-rate > 1% for 5m
- p95 latency > 1s for 10m (pager)

Ana (Solutions): Also enable model-version pinning and rollout policy: canary 5% then 100% if no regressions. Keeps us safe mid-test.
Matt (Infra): I'll add an autoscale policy override for the test window so we don't drop min capacity.
Jess (Oncall): Can someone confirm KMS access for Clearsky service account? I hit a denied in staging earlier.
Matt (Infra): Confirmed — fixed IAM mapping. KMS logs accessible at s3://redwood-logs/clearsky/kms/171843
Sarika (CSM): Quick enablement for Clearsky engineering: 30m walkthrough Fri 11:00 PT? Demo warmup steps + how to interpret the dashboard. They want a recording.
Ana (Solutions): I'll run the enablement and include the replay script and sample prompts.
Jess (Oncall): After soak I'll run a short chaos test: temporarily reduce pool to min=4 for 10m to validate graceful fallback. Will give heads-up 15m prior.
Sarika (CSM): Noted. Risk flag: if p95 > 900ms at soak we'll schedule an immediate follow-up with Clearsky execs. Keep me posted.
Tim (SRE): I will post the test dashboard link and the retention window for traces (48h).
DeployBot: Load test resources provisioned: jmeter-nodes=6, controller=1.
Ana (Solutions): One last ask — can we capture qualitative feedback after the enablement (short form)? I'll send a 3-question survey.
Sarika (CSM): Perfect. Team owners: Jess (run + chaos), Matt (infra & KMS), Ana (enablement + runbook), Tim (alerts + SLO). I'll update Clearsky and loop in AM. :white_check_mark:
